publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
reliability: Primary agency description of its workflow/rule; reliable within stated scope, not independent customer-demand evidence. HTTP 200 public HTML read on access date.
findings: The page describes DBRA coverage of contractors and subcontractors on federally funded or assisted construction contracts in excess of $2,000, and prevailing wage/fringe benefit obligations.
The page identifies a preliminary injunction affecting three provisions of the 2023 rule and says the remainder remains in effect.
limitations: Coverage and injunction guidance are the page as accessed, not a legal opinion or a guarantee of the current status of every court proceeding.
It does not quantify small-contractor administrative pain. Scope must be checked against the actual contract and applicable law.
title: Davis-Bacon and Related Acts
